title: From Toronto: Cranberry Plunge and Hardy Lake Hike Adventure

cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Explore the stunning Muskoka region on a day full of autumn colors and outdoor activities. Start off in Gravenhurst for brunch, then dive into the vibrant Cranberry harvest at Muskoka Lakes Farm and Winery, where you’ll don chest waders for a unique photo opportunity. Next, enjoy hitting the trails at Hardy Lake Provincial Park. Tailored to your group's skill level, this hike features some of the best views in the area. Perfect for nature lovers and adventure seekers, this tour includes transportation in a comfortable 15-passenger transit, with onboard amenities for a fun journey.

- Enjoy a scenic day in Muskoka during the beautiful fall season
- Experience the Cranberry plunge with provided waders for a unique photo op
- Hike tailored to your group's abilities at Hardy Lake Provincial Park
